name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad and grasp a barbell with an overhand palms-down grip.
Start with your arms extended down the pad with a slight unlock at the elbows.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms pinned against the pad.
Lower the bar slowly back toward full extension without letting your wrists collapse.
tips: Keep your wrists aligned straight with your forearms throughout each repetition.
Keep your chest against the pad and lower the bar without lifting your upper arms.
